item.title: Oklahoma’s Housing Paradox: Vacant Units Everywhere, Affordable Ones Nowhere - Oklahoma Gazette
item.description: Oklahoma has more than 220,000 vacant housing units, yet faces a shortage of 80,000 rental homes affordable to its lowest-income residents. Rising construction costs, aging housing stock and a broken financing system mean empty buildings coexist with a housing crisis — and experts say there is no single fix.
